new_bridge.direct_swap_identity: For adjacent incomparable u,v in the Q-projection, swapping their positions in a full lift gives an involution on valid swaps; W_C(uv)-W_C(vu) equals forward C-blocker mass minus reverse C-blocker mass.
new_bridge.ordered_profiles: If lambda(u)<=lambda(v) and rho(u)<=rho(v), reverse C-blockers are absent and the exact weight gradient equals the number of forward lifts having at least one chain blocker between u and v.
new_bridge.blocker_segments: Forward chain blockers are exactly indices lambda(u)<j<=lambda(v) below v/incomparable u and rho(u)<j<=rho(v) above u/incomparable v; their total raw count is the interval midpoint displacement.
new_bridge.one_element_recovery: For |C|=1 an incomparable ordered profile has at most one chain blocker, recovering account04/B20's |Delta W|<=1 theorem.
new_bridge.collective_connection: The chain-deletion weight gradient is the projected-fiber form of account03/B11's swap-defect blocker obstruction. Nested profiles are precisely the signed two-sided blocker case.

next_obligation: Use the signed blocker-union formula simultaneously across a three-chain cover to show the three required balance-destroying chain projections cannot coexist in the connected module-prime strong-majority core, or isolate a further exact invariant.
